title: Uke O Ono
description: Uke O Ono are an Edinburgh ukulele band playing Ballads & Bangers: tender singalongs and daft anthems. Here's where to catch us next.

show.title: Ballads & Bangers
show.blurb: Edinburgh's loudest ukulele band. Tender ballads, daft bangers, and a roomful of singing strangers.

gigs.name: A Leith Wedding
gigs.blurb: Somebody's big day, and we're the band. It's a private party, so no tickets, just our congratulations to the happy couple.

gigs.name: The Bowlers Rest Singalong
gigs.blurb: The residency starts here. We're back at our Leith local every month from now on, so bring a voice, bring a ukulele, bring both.

gigs.name: The Beatles Marathon UK
gigs.blurb: A full day of Fab Four hits, played by local bands. We are bringing the ukuleles.

gigs.name: A Leith Wedding
gigs.blurb: Another Leith wedding, another dance floor to fill. Private party again, so raise a glass from afar.

gigs.name: The Bowlers Rest Hogmanay Singalong
gigs.blurb: Hogmanay, a day early. Auld Lang Syne, a sackful of bangers and a pub full of voices to sing the year out.
